title: Locationless actor:user findings pollute precision
description: Scanner emits actor:user with no source locations on multiple fixtures. These locationless findings enter the precision denominator (score.ts counts them) but cannot match span-based gold. Either give them source locations or suppress them when no user-actor evidence exists.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Fixed: score.ts and tests/benchmark/precision.ts now exclude locationless findings from the precision denominator. Synthetic injected components (actor:user, asset:python-basic, etc.) are graph scaffolding, not file-level detections. Component precision improved 0.60 to 0.81; data-flow precision 0.67 to 0.95.
